text: Risk management is the process of identifying possible problems before they happen and finding ways to reduce their impact. The first step is to identify risks, which means looking carefully at what could go wrong in a project or situation. After that, you need mitigation strategies, which are actions that lower the chance of a risk occurring or limit the damage it causes. It is also wise to prepare contingency plans, so you have a backup solution ready if things fail. Finally, monitoring is essential because risks can change over time. By checking regularly, you can notice new dangers early and adjust your plans quickly.
